source: KCMO Chapter 18 Building and Rehabilitation Code / Development Process Guide

rules.rule: Building permit required for regulated construction
rules.condition: New construction, additions, alterations, repairs, demolition, and occupancy changes generally require a permit application through CompassKC.

rules.rule: Number of stories required for plan review scoping
rules.condition: Provide number of stories so height and egress scoping can be evaluated.

rules.rule: Building area required for plan review scoping
rules.condition: Provide building area (sq ft) for fee and review scoping.
